title: The Red Bag
subtitle: A small act of kindness
description: Sam finds a bag on the way home. A short, simple story about finding something — and doing the right thing.

pages.title: On the path
pages.text:
Sam has a red bag.
In the bag is a pen and a map.
Sam sits on a log.
The bag is on the path.

pages.title: A little help
pages.text:
A man runs past the log.
He trips on the bag.
Sam gets up.
“Can I help?” Sam asks.

pages.title: Back on the path
pages.text:
“Yes, thank you,” the man says.
Sam puts the bag on the log.
The man has a big grin.
A little help can mean a lot.

pages.title: Think about the story
pages.instructions: Choose an answer for each question. You can look back at the story whenever you like.

questions.hint: The first sentence tells you the colour.

questions.prompt: Where does Sam put the bag at the end?
questions.hint: Read the third page again. Sam moves the bag off the path.

pages.title: Find the missing words
pages.instructions: Type the word that completes each sentence.

questions.prompt: In the bag is a ___ and a map.
questions.hint: It is something you can write with.
Find the word for a smile on the last story page.
